description: Land Aquisition - Revocation Order Under Section 39 (1) Heenmoragolla, Dambulla  D/S Division, Matale District, - Correction paper. Order Under Section 39(a) 1 Amended Gazette No. and Date.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, specifically the revocation and correction of land acquisition orders under the Land Acquisition Act. The document contains detailed land descriptions, plot numbers, boundaries, and legal procedures related to land redemption. While a minister's name appears, it is in the context of executing land-related legal authority rather than describing government personnel changes or ministerial portfolios. The core subject matter is land administration, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
